item.title: Version 0.4.3
item.description:
Choose which microphone TalkKey listens to.

  • New: Microphone in the TalkKey menu. Pick any connected mic, or System Default to follow your Mac's Sound settings.
  • Tip: with AirPods connected, choose your Mac's built-in microphone so your AirPods keep full audio quality while you dictate.
  • If the mic you picked is unplugged, TalkKey uses your default mic until it's back.
  • If TalkKey hears only silence, it now points you to the Microphone menu.

item.title: Version 0.4.2
item.description:
Fixes for microphone problems and slow dictations.

  • If TalkKey hears only silence, it no longer types "you" — it beeps and tells you whether to check Microphone permission or your input device.
  • Faster, more consistent transcription: Whisper retries far less on unclear audio (some dictations took 5 seconds).
  • Grammar cleanup now gives up after 1.5 seconds and types your words as-is, instead of sometimes taking 3+ seconds.
  • Troubleshooting report now shows microphone permission and input device.
  • About window: privacy text now mentions update checks.

item.title: Version 0.4.1
item.description:
Automatic updates.

  • New: Check for Updates… in the TalkKey menu. TalkKey also checks once a day and offers new versions with one-click Install and Relaunch.
  • Updates are signed and verified before installing.
  • Includes 0.4.0's two hotkeys (F15 and fn by default).

If you have 0.4.0 or earlier, download this version once; after that, updates come to you.
